content.short: Aurory is a play-to-earn Japanese role-playing game built on Solana.
content.description: First released in 2022, Aurory is a free, blockchain-powered tactical Japanese role-playing game built on Solana. It uses a play-to-earn model in which players face off with others using creatures called Nefties, each of which is an NFT. Nefties can be hatched, evolved, battled, and traded. By staking, trading Nefties, and using other in-game items, players earn the AURY token, which can be exchanged for fiat or other cryptocurrencies.
